---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like?**
A clear description of the feature or improvement.

**What problem does it solve?**
The use case behind it.

**Alternatives you've considered**
Anything you tried or thought about.

**Keeping it simple**
This project intentionally avoids heavy dependencies (no vector DB / RAG). If your idea adds
one, note why the payoff is worth it.
